optimize_llama_for_gaudi: replace llama model classes with Gaudi-optimized versions including attention, MLP, decoder layer, and rotary embedding
optimize_qwen_for_gaudi: replace qwen2 and qwen3 model classes with Gaudi-optimized versions including MoE variants and vision language models
